propositions: Baseline description must store normalized text via normalize_rich_text(raw) instead of raw ADF dict or passthrough string
Baseline status and priority must store exact Jira name strings (e.g. 'In Progress' and 'High') rather than local-mapped values or dicts
Baseline assignee field must preserve the complete vendor dict shape and identity forms unchanged to prevent concurrent remote edits from being overwritten
The projection helper must be idempotent for already-scalar values and preserve field absence across description, status, and priority fields
Normalized baselines must produce identical compute_update_fields verdicts compared to raw vendor-shaped baselines when passed through real Jira inbound/outbound mappers
The pre-A3 dual-shape reader must accept both scalar and vendor dict forms during rollback without data loss or lossy denormalization
